This document outlines the major 
maintenance procedure P1, which must be carried on an annually bases 
as indicated by Y1 in the title 
block.

used for 
for supplying the boiler with 
combustion air

The first draft initiated by eng. Fawzy 
Ahmed Bsiouny, tested at 04 Nov.2003, 
reviewed by maintenance 
director: eng. Saad Mostafa, revised by EDEPCo. quality control eng. Samir Abdel Gilel, 
accepted by maintenance general director eng. 
Ali 
Mostafa Al-lithy 
and approved by eng. 
Awad Mohammed Fathy Soliman Head Sector of 
TALKHA power station.

A work permit 
 must be issued and the qualified maintenance staff should carry the suitable 
 safety category,

Safety fence (rope) with caution marks surrounding the work area is 
 required.

Wear safety 
 helmet, and safety shoes ... etc

Isolate the 
 circuit breaker for the re-circulation gas fan and its lubrication system.

Disassembly of the Rear and Front Cooling Disk 
Figure (1)

items:
Dismantle the safety cover (1) of 
 cooling disk.

Screw off the nuts (2) of bolts 
 which tighten the two halves of cooling disk around the fan shaft (3)

Lift the two halves of cooling disk 
 (4)

Dismantle the safety cover of 
 coupling.

Screw off the bolt (1), which 
 connected the coupling cover (2) with its coupling half.

Remove the two covers of coupling 
 away from both.

Take out the two halves of coupling 
 spring (3).

sections.text:
Disassembly of the Rear and 
Front Bearing House 
 Figure (3)

items: Take out the temperature sensor.
Drain the oil from the bearing house.
Disassemble all lubricating oil hoses.

Screw off the bolts (3) which connected 
 bearing house cover (2) with upper / bottom halves of bearing house (1/1&1/2).

Screw off the bolt (4), which connected two 
 halves of bearing house (1/1&1/2).
Take up the upper half of bearing house (1/1).
Open the main hall of the fan.

Screw of the bolts which tighten the 
 upper pin with loading blades one by one

Screw of the bolts which tighten the 
 lower pin with loading blades one by one

Take out the loading blades one by 
 one out side the fan casing

Inspect and 
 repair or exchange the defected parts
Clean every part well.

Check the Coupling springs from any 
 mechanical wear.

Check the two halves coupling from 
 any mechanical wear.

Repair or exchange any part if 
 needed.
Re-grease the coupling springs
Clean every part well.

Check the bearing from any 
 mechanical wear.

Check the two halves of bearing 
 house from any mechanical wear or damage.

Repair or exchange any part if 
 needed.
Clean every part well

Check 
 the upper guides pins and bushes from mechanical wear and exchange it if 
 needed

Check 
 lower guide pins with loading levers and pin bushes from mechanical wear 
 exchange if needed

Check 
 the loading blades from mechanical wear and repair any defect
Clean every part well.

Check the shaft from any defect 
 (Cracks, deflection) and repair or exchange it if needed.

Check the impeller from any defect 
 (mechanical wear or corrosion,.) and repair or exchange it if needed.

Check the foundation from any defect 
 and repair it if needed.
Clean every part well.

Assemble every part in reverse 
 sequence of disassembly.
Use the recommended/ or equivalent oil type.

After successful 
 inspection, operate the fan again, read all the available record value and 
 putted in table (1) to compare between the values before and after inspection.
